feat(facts): the payload a template reads is composed from the document (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)

The payload, the globals a draw builds its options from and the facts document
are one turn, stamped together in one reaction, so a draw never mixes a
document with a request or a pick it was not composed from. A turn takes its
closure and lanes from the view's one declaration. A turn that cannot be
stamped keeps the last one and surfaces as a warning in the bar's indicator.
A view that fails to open releases what it began. The check command stamps a
fixture document and composes through the same function; its hand-written
payload and checkToday are gone.

test(facts): pin the bar, the view's payload and check's payload per preset (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.83l)

Drawn from the daemon's session source over fixed owners at a fixed instant, so
composing the payload from the document can be judged against bytes: the bar
must not move, and the payload snapshot's diff is where the accepted
differences show. The payload-owners fakes hold their answers in observables,
as the real owners do, so a view's computed sees a lane land.

feat(sources): a failed shell read carries the command's stderr; the launcher names its timeout (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.dr2)

A shell source's failed read now ends in what the command wrote to
stderr, trimmed and shown by its last 2000 characters, on every arm but
an output flood or a failed pipe. A timeout result carries
`timed out after N s` from the launch's own bound, so the shell reader
and the daemon's runs read it instead of spelling it from constants of
their own.

feat(sources): a source's identity is a digest, one digest is one run (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.5dx) (#614)

* feat(sources): a source's identity is a digest, one digest is one run, and a moved key's old value stands until the new run lands (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.5dx)

A shell or file source is identified by a digest of what its run needs (the
read, the parser without its default, the normalised policy, the hash of the
key's value), and one daemon-wide owner, two KeyedSource instances by read
kind, runs each identity once for every registry that holds it. The registry
holds entries through Holds, publishes only answered readings into its node,
and derives what a request waits on from the lanes still pending. KeyedSource
takes its per-entry refresh, a watch per entry and the flight's abort signal
as spec data; an abandoned read is its own event, not a failure. The ledger
records user sources per read kind (source.shell, source.file), each refresh
naming its digest and how many homes share it.

* test(sources): two views keyed on one drawn depth share one run (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.5dx)

* fix(sources): an abandoned read is the ledger's own count, the run owner's stats reach the stats reply, and a watch takes the held guard (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.5dx)

* fix(sources): medium-pass fixes — one-shot owners close their runs, one canonical digest, errno on unreadable file (candybar-gather-renderer-76bb.6pj.5dx)
